resources.string: You chose a new icon and logo. They take effect after MPTV restarts.
This address is for the MPTV app on your other device. Open Local sync there and pick this device from the list.
This device could not be reached. On it, open MPTV → More → Local sync and turn Sync mode on. Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Colour of the MPTV icon and logo
Stage draws MPTV’s own soft colours. Picture shows a picture of yours behind every screen. Plain is a flat dark fill.
The MPTV logo in the menu, About and setup shows its play triangle in your accent colour. The icon on the home screen keeps its own colours.
Looks on GitHub for a newer MPTV now and offers to install it. Your playlists, favourites and settings stay as they are.
What MPTV shows when it starts: Home, the channel you watched last, your favourites, or a channel you pick.
